notes.title: Last Update
notes.content:
[h1]Patch Notes: Final Update Before Release[/h1]
Play the game now before the official release to take advantage of the discount and provide your feedback! Your input can help us make adjustments before the big launch.

[h2]Final Bosses[/h2]
Each map now has a unique final boss with special abilities:
[list]
[*] Islands: Squid King
[*] Savannah: Yggdrasil
[*] Vulcanery: Magma Colossus
[/list]

[h2]Vulcanery[/h2]
The Vulcanery map has undergone a major overhaul.
[list]
[*] We added flowing lava rivers and erupting volcanoes.
[*] It’s now more beautiful, thrilling, and fiery than ever before.
[/list]

[h2]Monster Nests[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can now see which monsters spawn from each nest.
[*] The boss nest now also spawns regular monsters. To simplify the game and provide a smoother start, the first normal nest has been removed.Drill to the Stars!
[/list]

[h2]Miscellaneous[/h2]
[list]
[*] A huge visual upgrade: more and better particle effects make the game much more appealing.
[*] You can now track how many times you’ve defeated specific enemies... time to start hunting!
[*] Buff towers have been improved and are more common in Endless Mode, allowing you to build stronger bases.
[*] Missing achievements for the champion Engineer have been added.
[*] Potions become stronger in the late game
[*] As the Funneler, you can no longer choose walls during tower selections. However, with all other champions, you can now always choose walls.
[*] Balance changes for a more refined gameplay experience.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix (1.4.1)
notes.content: Now all changes that were supposed to work for 1.4 actually work (I hope).

notes.title: The Upgrade Update (1.4)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474891/a15c31face9347aa68024824d3b9d0a763dab76e.png[/img]

[h1]The Upgrade-Update![/h1]

- We reworked the upgrade system, featuring special upgrades for certain towers! 6 of them are available through this update

- many Quality-of-Life changes including a better tactic view manager and better winning/loosing screens

- fixed Achievements (Valkyrie and MixedMoon are now possible to achieve)

- Balance changes (reworked waves, nerfed bosses, nerfed elemental cannons)

notes.title: The Fly Update (1.3)
notes.content:
- Added the Shield Fly and the Kamikaze enemies
- Added the Air Defense tower
- Added the Sky Spikes passives
- Push Traps will now self destruct after 4 uses to avoid soft locks
- smaller bug fixes

notes.title: Second Content Update - "Engineering"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44474891/6357b2c08fcc229f5e5915b3df511a245b638416.png[/img]

[h1]Our second content update![/h1]

[h3]New Champion: The Engineer[/h3]

Say hello to the new champion! He is very challenging but clever. Try him out ingame! But first you have to unlock them :)

[h3]2 new passives[/h3]

- Steam Drill
- Exploding Walls

[h3]2 new potions[/h3]

- Morph
- Repair

[h3]Balance Changes[/h3]

- Flies nerfed
- Slubber nerfed
- Elemental Cannons nerfed
- Wall-Bufftowers have more range
- Bosses deal less damage
- Bosses receive less knockback

[h3]More Changes[/h3]

- [b]Destroying buildings, walls, traps does not do damage to your drill![/b]
- Mountains have alternate graphics
- Fixed the portal

notes.title: Early Access out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Drill to the Stars goes Early Access![/h1]
For the first month we will update the game "Drill to the Stars" every single week. We want to add more towers, champions, maps, enemies and so on. If the fanbase grows, the game will be updated every two weeks for about half a year. We believe in the game's potential, but we need players to make informed design decisions. Building a close relationship with our community is very important to us so make sure to give us feedback via Discord: https://discord.gg/DZ3pXhzpxn.
HAVE FUN!
